properties.text: Browser: Download saves a copy. Desktop app: Open folder shows the release's files.

The release row returns to Ask for notes.

The failure shows in the notes card; the release and its files are unchanged.
Approved notes are stored with the release and stay after a restart.
Reject discards the draft and stores nothing.
